The plate is about 350 px across in the image, and I'm taking it as roughly 26 cm, so about 13 px per cm.

The meat patch is about 130 px wide and 100 px tall, which is roughly 10 × 7 cm. That looks like a thin steak or piece of meat about 1.5 cm thick, so about 90–100 g. Cooked beef runs about 2.2 kcal/g, which gives roughly 200 kcal.

The roasted potato pieces number about 7, each about 3 cm across. Each weighs roughly 25 g, so about 175 g in total. At about 1.5 kcal/g with the oil they were cooked in, that is roughly 260 kcal.

Combined, that comes to about 270 g of food and roughly 460 kcal.
